text: Coffee with Phoebe. Her dad's funeral is on the 3rd of November at the crematorium in Hove. She's holding up but tired. Matteo is driving her down. Must send flowers to her mum's house before then.

Siobhan's birthday is 14 May. She's gone mad for pottery, keeps talking about a wheel class in Brighton. Voucher for that would go down well. Her girlfriend Afua said she's also after a decent apron, the clay gets everywhere. Afua's planning drinks for her that weekend but nothing fixed yet, probably the Saturday after.

Long call with Afua tonight. Tendai got made redundant on Friday, totally out of the blue after nine years at the bank. She says he's putting a brave face on it but isn't sleeping. Their daughter Zainab starts uni in Leeds sometime next month so money's on their minds. I should check in with Tendai at the weekend, maybe take him for a pint.
Reggie and Carmen split up. Apparently it's been coming for a while. He's moved into his brother Leon's spare room for now. Reggie seemed fine, honestly, a bit relieved.
Salma mentioned her nan passed away last week. Funeral's early December, waiting on a date. She's flying out to Lahore for it.

Gemma's 40th is end of the month, she's doing a meal at that Italian place on the high street. Her husband Jonah says she wants nothing but has been eyeing up a Le Creuset casserole dish. Don't forget to chip in with Lucy for it.
Haircut booked for 12/11. Pick up dry cleaning before.

Caught Yetunde at the school gates. Her mum's in hospital again, the heart thing, and they're not sure when she'll be home. Yetunde looks exhausted. She asked if I could take her twins Thursday afternoon. Already said yes.
Dana lost her job. Whole team let go on the 2nd of October. She's applying for stuff but nervous about interviews, hasn't done one in ages. Remind me to send her that recruiter's details.
Emily's into bouldering now, goes three times a week with her flatmate Shreya. Shreya's birthday is 21st of March, apparently she collects vintage climbing posters.

Malik and Helen are getting married over the summer, probably August. Venue still not booked. He's stressing about the guest list because of his dad's side, there was some big falling out after his grandad's funeral two years ago and half of them aren't speaking. Helen just wants something small in Italy. Tell Malik about the barn place near Lewes.
Quick one: Ivan's dog Biscuit had to be put to sleep on Monday. He was gutted. Text him tomorrow.
Lola's grandad died. She was really close to him. Funeral sometime next week, no date yet. Her brother Emeka is flying back from Toronto. Need to ask Lola if she wants company on the day.

Tamar told me she's leaving the agency end of January, starting her own design studio in the spring. Scary but exciting. She's got a cat called Pickle who apparently sits on the keyboard all day. Her partner Wiremu is fully behind it and is going to do her accounts. Tamar's launch party will be sometime in March. I should introduce her to Jorge, he's been after a designer for the restaurant rebrand.
Ran into Elena and Olivia at the market. They're doing a joint birthday party on the 9th of December, both turning 30. Elena's into sourdough, Olivia's all about houseplants. Easy gifts at least.
Wiremu called. His wife Helen's surgery got moved to 18/11. He's taking the week off. Must ring him the day after to see how it went.
Lukas has been really low since the breakup with Jorge. Says he can't face the flat they shared and is looking to move out soon. Ugh.
Dev's birthday is sometime in early March, he couldn't remember the exact date himself. Loves F1, supports McLaren. Maybe a Silverstone ticket?
Darius is gutted, his redundancy meeting is on 4 November. HR said it's a formality. Wife's expecting their second in the new year too. I should message him that morning.

Dinner at Phoebe's last night. Matteo was there with his new girlfriend Carmen, who seems lovely, works as a vet nurse in Croydon. Phoebe's sister Siobhan is moving to Glasgow after Christmas for a new job, and Phoebe's clearly sad about it though she won't say. Matteo's 35th is on the 27th of this month, he wants a low-key pub thing. Don't forget a card.
Zainab got into the choir! Rehearsals start after half term. She was so nervous at the audition.
Afua said the memorial for her aunt has been called off, family fallout. She's upset about it.
Mrs Khan from next door says her son Malik is back from Dubai for good, sometime before Christmas. She's thrilled.
Note for Reggie's birthday, 30/06. Into vinyl, big on 70s soul. Has everything by Al Green already.
Gemma called sobbing. Her and Jonah have split, he moved out on Sunday. Kids are staying with her. She asked me not to tell anyone yet. I need to pop round with food this week.
Uncle Tendai's 70th is 15 February. Mum wants to do a surprise lunch. I'm handling the cake.
Salma's cat Mango went missing three days ago. She's put flyers up everywhere. Share her post on the street WhatsApp.
Spoke to Helen about her mum's diagnosis. Early stage dementia. Helen's going part time from January to help out. She sounded so worn down. Ring her sometime next week, properly, not just a text.
Lucy's starting at the new school on 5 January, head of maths. She's dreading the commute though. Her partner Dana thinks they'll end up moving closer.

Big catch-up with the uni lot. Emily's pregnant, due in May, first one. Ivan got promoted to partner. Shreya's doing a PhD in Edinburgh from September. And poor Leon's dad died in the summer, he's still not really himself, barely said a word all night. Remind me to message Leon separately.
Olivia's housewarming was meant to be Saturday but it's off, the boiler packed in. Rescheduled to sometime in the new year.
Need to sort the car MOT end of the month and renew the passport before spring.
Elena mentioned her brother Lukas is doing the Manchester marathon on 26th April, first ever. He's terrified. I should send him good luck the day before.

Wiremu's daughter graduates on 11 July. He's so proud. Been learning the haka for the party, which is very him. His daughter's name is Lola, studying marine biology at Plymouth, and she's already got a job lined up in Cornwall over the summer. His mum is flying in from Auckland for it, first trip over in years. Card and something ocean-themed for Lola.
Dev and Tamar are off to Japan in the spring, three weeks, cherry blossom season. Their dog Kiwi is going to his mum's. Tamar's anxious about the long flight.
Afua's birthday is 2nd of August. She's been hinting about noise-cancelling headphones for months.
Followed up with Jorge about the redundancy consultation on Monday. They're keeping him on! Massive relief. Should send a congrats bottle.

Siobhan rang. Her mum's funeral was yesterday and it went OK, lots of people came. She's taking a couple of weeks off work. Her partner Darius is being great apparently. I should check in with her early next week.
Yetunde's son Emeka has his driving test on 17/12. Third attempt, he's a bag of nerves. She asked me to keep it quiet.
Phoebe's into wild swimming, goes every Sunday at the lido even in winter. Mad.

Coffee with Carmen. She's been made redundant from the charity, last day is 30 November. Weirdly upbeat, wants to retrain as a teacher, maybe start a PGCE next September. Her husband Jorge is less relaxed about it. They've got a mortgage and two kids. Her birthday's mid-December too so maybe something small and nice then. Text her after her last day.
Matteo Bianchi from work told me his mum passed away over the weekend. He's off until after the funeral, which is around the 12th. Organise a card for the team to sign.
Lola and Emeka are celebrating ten years married on the 6th of September. Talking about Lisbon for it.
Didn't get to talk much with Malik. Seemed quiet. His girlfriend Salma said work's been brutal and he might be next in the redundancies, sometime early March. I'll take him out for a curry soon.
Helen loves anything Moomin. Mugs, prints, the lot. Her birthday's sometime in June, need to find out exact date.
Gym, then food shop. Nothing else today.

Dana's brother Ivan is in a bad way after his divorce came through on the 1st of October. She's worried. He's moved back in with their parents in Reading for now. Don't forget to ask Dana how he's getting on.
Jonah's starting a new job at the hospital trust soonish, maybe end of November. Pretty sure it's a big pay jump. Also he's taken up running with his neighbour Reggie.
Lucy said Emily's mum had a fall and broke her hip. Op was Tuesday, she's recovering at the Royal Sussex. Emily's been there every day. Lucy and I are going to visit together on Saturday.
Shreya told me about her break-up with Dev last month. She's OK now, honestly seems happier. Moving to a flat in Hackney on 1st of December. Lukas is helping her move.
Tamar's mum, Mrs Ito, turns 80 on the 3rd of April. Big family do. Tamar wants a photo book of her mum's life. I said I'd dig out old pics from the Lake District trip.

Elena got the redundancy letter. Her last day's before Christmas. Says she's fine with it, has been wanting out anyway. Already got an interview at the museum on 8/11. She was there for twelve years, so it's a big change. Her boss apparently cried when he told her. Elena's sister Gemma is throwing her a do sometime in mid-December. Must wish her luck the night before the interview.
Zainab's hamster died and she's devastated, poor kid. Afua's getting her a new one at the weekend.
Wiremu said his partner Olivia has a scan sometime next week, the follow-up one. He didn't say much more. Remind me to text him Friday.
Leon's 50th is in the spring, Carmen's planning something big. She asked everyone to keep 18 April free. He's obsessed with golf lately, so maybe lessons or a round at the posh place.
Reggie's dad's funeral was today. I couldn't go. Need to call him tonight.
Siobhan, aka Shiv, finally got the flat in Leith! Moving in sometime next month. She's thinking of getting a dog once she's settled.
Dr Ahmed called about Mum's results, all fine. Book her in for the next check in six months.

Ivan and Phoebe are hosting a leaving do for Darius on Friday the 14th. He's off to Berlin for a year. I'm bringing drinks. He's been really nervous about the language, keeps doing Duolingo on the bus.

Lunch with Gemma and Yetunde. Gemma's still raw after the split but getting there. Yetunde's daughter Lola starts nursery in January. Gemma's birthday is 22/02, she mentioned wanting a nice silk scarf.
